cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A claims only to clear the table while laying out evidence and deciding when it can be removed, making apology the quickest end to B inconvenience display.
confusable: Not seeking compensation: A rejects money and controls cleanup until the inconvenience is acknowledged.
comparison: Physical wetness at dinner versus timetable and receipt reconstruction.
